images.caption:
Exterior of the lodge, clouds are reflected in the glass windows
Jackson Lake Lodge Promenade
While the pavers of the promenade are placed according to a strict grid, the walkway meanders to create a dynamic form and an interesting visitor experience. In a few places, it widens to form geometric seating areas.

images.filename: File-West side, Jackson Lake Lodge Promenade- -The Jackson Lake Lodge Historic District is notable for its (e8b203fe-0728-478f-8e98-02baf340fd04).jpg
images.caption:
Paved pathway of the promenade
West side, Jackson Lake Lodge Promenade
The Jackson Lake Lodge Historic District is notable for its associations with the origins of the Mission 66 initiative and the adoption of modern architectural principles and forms by the NPS.  The geometric promenade and lawn of the main viewing terrace extend this formal modern design into the landscape.
While this represents a break with the NPS Rustic-style design tradition, the landscape features suggest influences of both styles.
Keywords: imr; grte; rustic style; mission 66; shoshone; jackson lake lodge; cultural landscape
